tool.name: SIMORGH
tool.description: Deep learning framework for apo-state and cryptic pocket prediction
tool.command: ln -s '$pdb' input.pdb #if str($bbflow_condi.bbflow) == 'yes': && bbflow_sample --input_path input.pdb --output_path bbflow.pdb --output_format pdb --num_samples $bbflow_condi.num_samples #if str($bbflow_condi.batch_size) != '' --batch_size $bbflow_condi.batch_size #end if --device cpu --timesteps $bbflow_condi.timesteps --tag $bbflow_condi.advanced.tag #if $bbflow_condi.advanced.gamma_trans: --gamma_trans $bbflow_condi.advanced.gamma_trans #end if #if $bbflow_condi.advanced.gamma_rots: --gamma_rots $bbflow_condi.advanced.gamma_rots #end if #end if && python /opt/SIMORGH/Model/inference.py #if str($bbflow_condi.bbflow) == 'yes': -i bbflow.pdb #else -i input.pdb #end if -o predicted.pdb --model1 /opt/SIMORGH/Model/model_4.pt --model2 /opt/SIMORGH/Model/model_44.pt #if str($cluster_condi.cluster) == 'yes': --cluster --cutoff $cluster_condi.cutoff --min-cluster-size $cluster_condi.min_cluster_size --min-samples $cluster_condi.min_samples --alpha $cluster_condi.alpha #end if

param.name: bbflow
param.label: Run BBflow?
param.help: It runs a structure-based conformational ensemble prediction with flow matching

param.label: Tag of the model to use
Gamma (translational)
param.help: Conditional prior parameter for the translational part. Leave blank to use the training configuration's value.

param.label: Gamma (rotational)
param.help: Conditional prior parameter for the rotational part. Leave blank to use the training configuration's value.

param.name: cluster
param.label: Run Clustering on predictions?
param.help: It runs HDBSCAN clustering on predictions

param.label: Probability weight in custom distance metric

tool.help:
What it does -------------
SIMORGH predicts apo-state and cryptic ligand-binding sites from a single protein structure. Given an input PDB file, it scores residues (or surface regions) for their likelihood of forming a cryptic or apo-state binding pocket, using an ensemble of two trained models, and writes out a PDB file with these predictions.
Because cryptic pockets are often only visible in specific, transiently sampled conformations, SIMORGH can optionally first generate an ensemble of alternative backbone conformations with BBflow before scoring — this can improve sensitivity to pockets that are not visible in the input structure as given, at the cost of longer runtime.
Predicted site scores can optionally be grouped into discrete pockets with HDBSCAN density-based clustering, which is useful when you want candidate binding sites as separate clusters rather than a per-residue/per-point probability map.
Inputs -------
* **PDB file**: the input protein structure to analyze.
* **Run BBflow?**: if enabled, samples alternative backbone conformations of the input structure before prediction.
* **Number of conformations to sample**: how many backbone conformations BBflow generates. * **Number of sampling timesteps**: number of integration steps used by the BBflow sampler; more timesteps can improve sample quality at the cost of runtime. * **Batch size**: number of conformations sampled per batch; left blank, it is estimated automatically. * **Advanced prior parameters (gamma_trans / gamma_rots)**: control how closely the sampling prior sticks to the input (equilibrium) structure. Left blank, the values from the model's training configuration are used.
* **Run Clustering on predictions?**: if enabled, groups predicted site points into clusters using HDBSCAN.
* **Probability cutoff for clustering**: minimum predicted probability for a point to be considered when forming clusters. * **HDBSCAN min_cluster_size**: minimum number of points required to form a cluster. * **HDBSCAN min_samples**: HDBSCAN density parameter; higher values yield more conservative (less noisy) clustering. * **Probability weight in custom distance metric**: weight given to the predicted probability, relative to spatial distance, when computing the distance metric used for clustering.
Outputs --------
* **Predicted Structure**: the input structure (or the BBflow-sampled conformation, if BBflow was run) annotated with predicted binding-site scores. * **BBflow Structure**: only produced if BBflow sampling was enabled; the backbone conformation(s) sampled by BBflow prior to prediction.
